title: AGENTS.md
text: Notes agents working actimetrics.

title: AGENTS.md
text: acti_calculate_counts() calls agcounts::calculate_counts(). data start epoch boundary (e.g. first sample 18:41:00.5 60 s epochs), agcounts pads start . agcounts PR #51 (issue #50) padding broken; fix_first_second_function() (R/ab_calculate_counts.R) pads data agcounts sees , agcounts padding branch never runs (data_start == t1).

what: What agcounts PR #51 fixed (merged 2026-10-15, agcounts 0.7.1 on GitHub main)
title: AGENTS.md
text: Crash wrong sign '' argument first sample < 1 s epoch boundary (padded seq(data_start, t1 - 1, ...)). 1-second gap: padding stopped t1 - 1 instead just t1. PR #51, counts identical without padding example GT3X (starts 0.5 s 37.5 s past minute checked).

what: What agcounts still gets wrong (as of PR #51)
title: AGENTS.md
text: Extra columns: padding rbind(data.frame(time, X, Y, Z), raw), errors (numbers columns arguments match) raw columns (e.g. GENEActiv light, temperature). reachable acti_calculate_counts(resample = FALSE): actibase::acti_resample() already drops non-XYZ columns. Spurious zero-count rows (agcounts issue #42): expected-timestamp grid built unaligned first time, appends zero rows duplicate epochs (39 real minutes -> 78 rows). acti_calculate_counts() fixes flooring time epoch summing. Version: Suggests requires agcounts (>= 0.6.7); CRAN release may contain PR #51.

what: Why we keep fix_first_second = TRUE as the default
title: AGENTS.md
text: Padding first avoids three: agcounts sees aligned data, neither padding (rbind) unaligned timestamp grid used, regardless installed agcounts version. padding keeps columns attributes, uses exact sample grid epoch start, keeps timezone. acti_calculate_counts() also runs acti_standardize_data(subset_xyz = TRUE) first, agcounts ever sees time/X/Y/Z (also maps names like TIME/HEADER_TIME_STAMP lower-case x). fixes (1) even fix_first_second = FALSE, keeps sample_rate transformations attributes. fix (2) (3), padding stays. remove floor--sum step agcounts::calculate_counts() padding without re-checking cases.

what: Create Metrics Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
title: Create Metrics Actigraphy and Activity Analysis
text: actimetrics provides helpers actigraphy preprocessing, summary statistics, count-based overlays, MIMS-oriented processing. Core entry points: calculate_measures() summary metrics AI, MAD, MIMS, AC acti_calculate_counts() acti_process() count wear overlays mims_default_processing() default MIMS preprocessing chain acti_calibrate() calibration agcounts using van Hees method commonly implemented GGIR

text: epoch/unit arguments standardized actibase::acti_standardize_epoch(), acti_calculate_counts() accepts epoch = "1 min" measure functions accept numeric seconds strings "30s". ensure_all_time = TRUE longer errors units "5 seconds" "1 minute", acti_calculate_mims() longer errors units without space "1min". acti_calculate_ai() acti_calculate_mad() now default verbose = TRUE. acti_apply_cole_kripke(), acti_apply_sadeh(), acti_apply_tudor_locke() longer add superfluous vector.magnitude column (copy counts) output. acti_apply_cole_kripke() acti_apply_sadeh() longer return count column actigraph.sleepr uses internally scoring (axis1 truncated , Cole-Kripke, divided 100). overwrote count column input, now kept.

text: acti_apply_cole_kripke(), acti_apply_sadeh(), acti_calculate_wear(use_magnitude = FALSE) now error axis1 missing. sleep algorithms score vertical axis, vector-magnitude counts longer silently converted axis1 = VM / sqrt(3). acti_calculate_wear() errors informative message unless data 60-second epochs (required Choi Troiano). Step summaries (acti_calculate_stepcount(), acti_calculate_verisense(), acti_calculate_forest(), acti_calculate_sdt()) now return NA epochs values missing (e.g. non-wear) rather 0 steps; walking acti_calculate_stepcount() likewise NA. allow_truncation = TRUE, acti_calculate_auc() acti_calculate_fast_mims() mark epoch --range axis -0.01 (axes total), MIMSunit , rather adding -1 sentinel total.

title: actimetrics 0.8.0
text: New acti_process_study() processes every supported raw file (GT3X, CWA, GENEActiv BIN, CSV) directory acti_process() saves RDS files. Failures always reported warning listed failed attribute result. CSV files read readr, now Imports. acti_apply_tudor_locke() gains sleep_col use sleep-state column another name (e.g. acti_apply_tudor_locke_diary()). acti_calculate_ai() documentation page describing (noise-unadjusted) Activity Index Bai et al. (2016).

title: actimetrics 0.8.0
text: acti_calculate_counts() subsets time/X/Y/Z calling agcounts, whose start--record padding failed data extra columns (e.g. GENEActiv light/temperature). first-second padding agcounts keeps columns, attributes, timezone, builds padded times exact sample grid, longer re-prefixes existing transformation history. kept default alongside upstream fix (bhelsel/agcounts#51), also avoids agcounts’ duplicate zero-count rows works older agcounts. acti_calculate_wear() now passes ... actigraph.sleepr (arguments min_period_len ignored) affected existing wear columns. mims_default_extrapolation(), mims_default_interpolation(), mims_default_filtering() now record transformations. acti_calculate_ai() skips 1-second windows single sample instead making whole epoch NA, warns data sampled 2 Hz. acti_calculate_verisense() validates method match.arg(), default "original". acti_calculate_fast_mims() uses sample rate processed (100 Hz) data; supplied sample_rate ignored warning. user-supplied sample_rate acti_calculate_measures() now passed activity-count calculation, missing sample rate gives informative error acti_calculate_counts(resample = FALSE). Epoch/unit strings "30s" "1min" parsed lubridate, consistent lubridate::floor_date(). py_acti_calculate_stepcount() py_acti_calculate_forest() return result visibly. Fixed aggregated_at_ transformation label documentation verbose lfe_select.
